## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup can be further refined by incorporating a trailing profit-lock mechanism to capture more of the trend's upside potential while maintaining the existing chart-stop-primary doctrine.

## Mechanism

The proposed mechanism involves arming a trailing profit-lock at +5% favor, which trails 0.15 off the high-water mark. This allows the trade to lock in gains as the move runs, while the chart-stop remains the primary invalidation mechanism.
